hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.jsonc|*.css|*.svg|*.astro|*.html) [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/biome ] || exit 0; out=$(./node_modules/.bin/biome check "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'biome check failed for %s. Run biome format --write on it, then re-check.\n%s\n' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
